subject: low-memory graph build policy
statement: Low-memory repository builds, workspace member refreshes, and project MCP refreshes preserve graph precision and result semantics while using aggressive garbage collection, selective transactional copying, and phase-boundary reclamation; max-memory is a soft Go-runtime memory target rather than an RSS or hard allocation cap, and existing stricter runtime limits are never relaxed.

evidence.scope: Soft runtime memory target parsing/application and CLI, workspace refresh, and MCP refresh wiring
Selective transactional enrichment, phase reclamation, result equivalence, CLI execution, and MCP capability regressions
